architectureDecisions: At baseline 7a266fc, packages/agentic-system/src/oracle.js owns both loops, imports ./contracts.js and ./qa-contracts.js, and is reached by backend-application.js, qa-application.js, src/index.js and scripts/artifact-manifest-eval.mjs. This is the physical ownership debt; packages/oracle does not yet exist.

Create packages/oracle as a private ESM workspace package with src/oracle.js and src/index.js. Move only the concrete repositoryReader.readFile and artifactReader.readArtifact iteration, error wrapping, sourceRef copying and QA APPLICATION_ARTIFACT provenance assembly there. The infrastructure package imports no agentic-system/core module, defines no work-order/context schemas, and owns no lifecycle, scheduling or acceptance decision.

Keep packages/agentic-system/src/oracle.js as a thin compatibility/application semantic adapter: parseBackendWorkOrder/parseQaWorkOrder before any read, call the two concrete package functions with the parsed order and injected reader, then BackendContextSchema.parse/QaContextSchema.parse on the returned shape. Preserve resolveBackendContext and resolveQaContext names, signatures, index exports and direct relative-path callers. There is no duplicate read loop in the adapter.

Declare packages/agentic-system/package.json dependencies.@exharness/oracle as file:../oracle so the package graph explicitly records Application -> Oracle, never the reverse. Keep an explicit relative ESM import ../../oracle/src/index.js in the compatibility adapter for the current no-install CI workflow (test.yml executes npm run verify directly); the private Oracle package exports its concrete API. BB-061 will decide whether/when to switch to package-specifier imports and install/lock wiring. Node/npm package metadata and the actual source import graph must both point Application -> Oracle, with no Oracle import from Application/Core.

Maintain exact observable contract: parse invalid work orders before invoking a reader; demand readFile/readArtifact methods before iterating; read each declared item in order; preserve request field names/null path and sourceRef; wrap reader exceptions with the existing Backend or QA error text and cause; preserve schema failure for malformed/absent content or sourceRef. The application remains owner of parsers and schema checks; Oracle assembles only requested data.

Preservation matrix at baseline 7a266fc: (a) parseBackendWorkOrder/parseQaWorkOrder rejects invalid order before any reader call; (b) reader method guard throws the exact existing TypeError; (c) Backend readFile receives repositoryRef/revision/path in requiredFiles order and wraps failures with path, ref, revision and cause; (d) QA readArtifact receives ref, path|null, upstream workOrderId/revision/acceptanceDecision in requiredArtifacts order and wraps failures with ref and cause; (e) sourceRef and content pass unchanged to application schemas, and QA adds APPLICATION_ARTIFACT producerWorkOrderId/acceptanceDecision provenance; (f) malformed/absent sourceRef/content still fails the same ContextSchema; (g) optional manifest reader remains injected before resolution and rejects manifest/provenance/digest mismatch; (h) durable Backend->QA consumes exact manifest ref after QA_PENDING. Each row must have before/after characterization evidence, not only a happy-path result.

Do not move createManifestArtifactReader, manifest store or captureAcceptedBackendArtifactManifest from packages/agentic-system/src/artifact-manifest.js in BB-060. That application-owned accepted-artifact/provenance validation happens before the injected reader reaches Oracle; BB-062 and BB-063 own concrete adapter topology and durable migration review.

Mark this as planned extraction only. After worker delivery update docs/living/system/oracle/{architecture,state,semantics,workflow}.md and affected Agentic Application docs to reflect observed source placement. Architecture tests should reject Oracle loops left in agentic-system or reverse package imports; BB-064 later owns the full end-to-end phase closure guard.

Declare the app's file:../oracle dependency in packages/agentic-system/package.json. Implement pullBackendFiles(parsedOrder,{repositoryReader}) and pullQaArtifacts(parsedOrder,{artifactReader}) in src/oracle.js, moving only the two existing read loops plus reader method check, catch/cause and QA provenance assembly. Inputs are already parsed by the caller; output is a plain object with exactly the preexisting repository/files or upstream/artifacts/acceptanceCriteria shape. No Oracle import from agentic-system.

O12 — Replace packages/agentic-system/src/oracle.js with two small application adapters. Each parses the raw order first, calls its corresponding infrastructure pull via ../../oracle/src/index.js, and validates the returned object with the existing application-owned ContextSchema.parse. Keep backend-application.js, qa-application.js, index.js and scripts/artifact-manifest-eval.mjs imports and observable exported APIs unchanged. Keep artifact-manifest.js above the injected reader and outside the new package.

O13 — Add packages/oracle/test/oracle.test.js and packages/agentic-system/test/oracle-integration.test.js with a before/after golden characterization matrix against baseline 7a266fc oracle.js: parse invalid order before IO; missing reader; exact Backend and QA reader arguments/order; sourceRef/content and QA provenance; wrapped error message and original cause; missing/malformed content or sourceRef schema failures; optional manifest wrong producer/revision/acceptance/content rejection; durable QA_PENDING recovery on same manifest ref. Keep existing BB-043 and BB-045 tests. The fixtures compare value and failure shape at the exported resolver APIs, not solely the new pull functions.

O14 — Add test/oracle-architecture-boundary.test.mjs with a reusable placement/import scan and negative fixtures for an Oracle read loop copied back into agentic-system/oracle.js; an Oracle -> agentic-system/Core import; a missing app package dependency or a reverse package dependency; and application schema imports from Oracle. Check both package.json dependency and actual ESM import directions. Run concrete unit/integration/regression commands; update current Oracle and affected application Living Docs with actual new physical topology. This slice establishes a BB-060 placement check, while BB-064 independently tests full phase drift and closure.

negativeVerificationCases: An invalid Backend/QA work order or missing reader still performs any source IO; reject before any read.
Backend repository reader returns a malformed/missing sourceRef or throws; the former must fail application schema, the latter must retain boundary message and original cause.
QA manifest reader returns wrong producer/revision/acceptance or tampered content; Oracle must pass no fabricated artifact and the existing manifest error remains as cause.
A concrete read loop remains in agentic-system/src/oracle.js or new Oracle source imports agentic-system/Core; architecture guard must fail on a dedicated negative fixture.
A new generic Resolver/provider registry, scheduling or acceptance import enters packages/oracle without a corresponding concrete objective; plan disallows this scope.
Package split edits application contracts or creates a package-name import requiring npm install while the existing CI runs verification without install; execution must fail until compatible.
The app package manifest omits its file:../oracle dependency, or Oracle's package manifest depends on agentic-system; architecture guard must reject both even if relative imports make tests pass.

The source migration reorders reads, loses original cause, omits accepted QA producer/decision provenance, or changes return/error shapes for the exported resolver API; before/after characterization matrix must fail.
